map.输入一段收盘价序列，计算移动平均MA、指数平滑异同MACD、相对强弱RSI与随机: Enter a series of closing prices to compute the moving average (MA), MACD, RSI, and KDJ, helping judge trends and trading signals for technical analysis.
map.MA(N) = Σ最近N个收盘价 / N；MACD：DIF = EMA(快) −: MA(N) = sum of the last N closing prices / N; MACD: DIF = EMA(fast) − EMA(slow), DEA = EMA(DIF, 9), histogram = (DIF − DEA) × 2; RSI = 100 − 100 / (1 + average gain / average loss); KDJ: RSV = (C − L9)/(H9 − L9)×100, K and D smoothed recursively, J = 3K − 2D
map.MA 为 N 日收盘均价；MACD 取快慢 EMA 之差（DIF）与其 9 日: MA is the N-day average close; MACD takes the difference of the fast and slow EMAs (DIF) together with its 9-day EMA (DEA), with the histogram twice their difference; RSI uses average gains and losses to gauge overbought and oversold levels; KDJ computes RSV first, then smooths into K and D, with the J line amplifying the signal.
map.计算移动均线（MA）、相对强弱（RSI）、指数平滑异同（MACD）等常用指标。: Computes commonly used indicators such as the moving average (MA), relative strength index (RSI), and MACD.
map.趋势（MA 多空排列）、超买超卖（RSI）、动能（MACD 金叉/死叉）判断。: Judges trends (MA alignment), overbought and oversold conditions (RSI), and momentum (MACD golden and death crosses).
map.多指标组合信号的初步验证。: A first check of combined multi-indicator signals.
map.：最近 20 日收盘均价，如 [48,49,50,51,52…] 均值为 50: : the 20-day average close, so [48,49,50,51,52…] with a mean of 50 → MA20=50. A price crossing above MA20 is often seen as short-term strength.
map.：RSI = 100 − 100/(1+RS)，RS=14 日平均涨幅/平均跌幅: : RSI = 100 − 100/(1+RS), where RS = 14-day average gain / average loss. RSI > 70 is overbought and < 30 oversold. If gains dominate over 14 days with RS = 2 → RSI = 100−100/3 ≈ 66.7 (strong but not overbought).
map.：DIF=EMA12−EMA26；DEA=EMA(DIF,9)；MACD柱=DI: : DIF = EMA12 − EMA26; DEA = EMA(DIF, 9); MACD histogram = DIF − DEA. DIF crossing above DEA is a golden cross (bullish).
map.由主动收益序列求跟踪误差: Derive the tracking error from the active return series
map.由日波动率求年化波动率: Derive annualized volatility from daily volatility
map.指标能单独决策吗？: Can Indicators Drive Decisions on Their Own?
map.不能。技术指标滞后且易假信号，宜多指标+量价+基本面共振，且严格止损。: No. Technical indicators lag and produce false signals easily, so combine several indicators with volume, price action, and fundamentals for confluence, and always use a strict stop.
